correctness.rationale: Verified the exact all-coefficient cover-image premise in Almeida Filho–Tafazolian–Vieira, (8), Lemma 6.1 and Theorem 6.6. The monomials are scalar eigenvectors of weight i+2s+1. Tame local descent of regular differentials and averaging an image preimage by the prime-field scalar 1/(2(p−1)) give the invariant image, also for semilinear Cartier. With T=p−1, Q=p^(h−2), the Qk admissible z values, k=T−s−t, give ((Q−1)/(2T))k complete blocks plus a short interval of length k. Only odd t can contribute in that interval and the condition is z=T−t−2s−1, giving T(T+2)/8. The block contribution is (Q−1)p(p+1)/12. Summing, then subtracting from the genus, verifies all formulas including h=2. BBTZ Proposition 2.1 with r=p and epsilon=2 gives the stated genus, and Theorem 1.3(ii), equation (9), supplies the arithmetic application hypotheses for n≥2. The archived checker was inspected but not executed; it is finite and specializes the coefficients. It is not necessary for the proof.

originality.rationale: The stronger published monomial image already determines all scalar eigenspaces of the first Cartier image. For the stated quotient one takes its weight-zero basis by standard tame descent. The claimed scalar rank is a closed evaluation of that already specified basis dimension; the choice of even support makes the residue sum a complete-block count and a triangular sum. This is stronger-theorem coverage of the exact rank and a-number, not evidence that the closed quotient formula is printed verbatim. The point-count and automorphism claims are explicitly prior as well.
